title: Offline growth of a fixed native cache image
description: 📏️ Schema-first contract of `repo cache grow`: a fixed APFS cache image is grown to the size its policy declares WITHOUT being born again. The image cannot grow while attached (hdiutil and diskutil refuse with EAGAIN), so the operation holds the image lease exclusively, detaches the image, resizes the backing file offline, attaches it again and re-stamps every record that names the old size or the old mount device. Every phase is recorded in a journal beside the receipt, so a killed run resumes where it stopped. / Schema-first Vertrag von `repo cache grow`: ein festes APFS-Cache-Image wird ohne Neugeburt auf die von der Richtlinie deklarierte Größe gebracht.
